name: crm_account
summary: Customer 360 account profiles, segments, tags, health and renewals
description: Deep account layer for the CRM: Customer 360 account profiles built on the shared contacts master (segment, industry, region, account manager, lifecycle), an explainable health score with documented rationale, reusable tags, saved dynamic segments, and renewal/retention tracking. Canonical identity stays in core.partner and financial records stay in Accounting - this module only owns the relationship view.
author: Nexa
